narrative.overview: PulseAhead is the calm, well-lit station a shift coordinator stands at to read the whole floor at a glance. Surfaces are light and cool-neutral, and most of the screen is quiet on purpose. The eye goes to the one place where flow is stuck: a status badge, a queue count, or a cluster of dots in the scene. Status is always spoken plainly in words, with an icon, and never by colour alone. Density is operational, not editorial. A three-column workspace holds controls and feeds on the left, the isometric four-zone scene in the centre, and the selected-zone drawer on the right. Numbers use tabular figures and sit right-aligned in key/value lists, so a coordinator can compare them down a column. Exactly one accent, Deep Clinical Teal, marks primary actions and the current selection, and nothing else. The 3D scene is a simple isometric diagram, not a realistic hospital. Flat pale platforms with hairline edges, small coloured patient dots and DOM labels carry the meaning. Depth exists only to show four zones in sequence.
keyCharacteristics: Light, cool-neutral ground with white panels; one teal accent.
Status always uses text, an icon and a tint together.
System font stack, a compact type scale and tabular numerals.
44px minimum targets on every control; a visible 3px teal focus ring.
A simple isometric scene; its labels are DOM text, so they stay readable at any zoom.

rules.name: The One Accent Rule
rules.body: Teal means "action or current selection". It never signals status, urgency or decoration.

rules.name: The Never Colour Alone Rule
rules.body: Every status or urgency colour is paired with text and an icon or size difference. A screen read in greyscale must lose no meaning.

rules.name: The Tabular Count Rule
rules.body: Every number a coordinator compares (counts, spaces, times) uses tabular numerals and sits in a consistent, right-aligned column.

rules.name: The Flat Panel Rule
rules.body: One shadow value, used at rest only. State changes use fill and border, never extra elevation.

dos: Do show every status with text, an icon and its ink/tint pair together.
Do keep every interactive target at least 44px and keep the 3px teal focus ring visible.
Do right-align numbers in key/value lists, using tabular numerals.
Do place scene labels on their own platform and check them for overlap at 375 and 1440px.
Do keep the "Synthetic demo" chip in the header on every screen.
donts: Don't use teal for status, urgency or decoration.
Don't add a second shadow or deeper elevation for hover or selection.
Don't put configuration or dense controls inside the 3D scene; they belong in the side panels.
Don't let a scene label run past its platform onto a neighbouring zone.
Don't use a display font, gradients or glossy materials; the scene stays a flat, pale diagram.
